programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: American Monster: Abuse of Power
programme.desc: From police officers to pastors, doctors to business leaders, they are the pillars of our communities. However, when power seduces and corrupts, it opens the door to evil, and some will stop at nothing, even murder, to protect themselves.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer
programme.desc: Disturbing yet empowering accounts of how people have escaped the clutches of a serial killer.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: An exploration into the dangers of meeting up with strangers through Internet dating sites. Featuring stories from families and friends of victims who have fallen victim to online predators.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: UFO experts Mitch Horowitz and Chrissy Newton use scientific data and research to dissect real-life encounters with extraterrestrial activity and determine whether they can be explained.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: Exploring the ripple effects of a single murder on multiple lives, as loved ones, eyewitnesses and law enforcement personnel reflect on how the past continues to haunt the present.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: Fictionalised first-person narratives are used to explore different cases of murder and betrayal at the hands of a loved one or friend.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Telling the real stories of men and women who lived happy, seemingly normal lives with the people they loved - and who they thought they knew. When a clue or mishap causes them to dig further into the secret lives of their spouses, the shocking truths lead them to wonder who it is they really fell in love with. The stories include husbands with multiple families, spies working under cover, those who steal thousands of dollars, and others whose double lives include murder.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Telling the real stories of men and women who lived happy, seemingly normal lives with the people they loved - and who they thought they knew. The stories include husbands with multiple families, spies working under cover, those who steal thousands of dollars, and others whose double lives include murder.

programme.title: All Girls Garage
programme.desc: Ladies, start your engines! `All Girls Garage' taps into the expertise of three women repairing cars and motorcycles in a shop setting. The `girls' are certified mechanic Sarah Lateiner, who goes by the nickname `Bogi'; TV host and motorsports reporter Cristy Lee; and mobile automotive repair pioneer Faye Hadley. Producers say the women approach complex projects - from upgrading the RAM Air on a rare Pontiac GTO Judge, to installing an exhaust system on a V10 Audi, to repairing a Suzuki Hyabusa motorcycle - that rival those undertaken by their male counterparts in order to prove they have what it takes to run a female-dominated car shop.

programme.title: Car Fix
programme.desc: The hosts repair and modify all types of cars and also suggest easy ways to fix car-related problems.

programme.title: Street Outlaws
programme.desc: Street racing in the US is the subject of this docu-reality series, which purportedly provides an inside look into the action both on the road and behind the scenes. In Oklahoma City, for example, racers boast having the fastest street cars in the country, and the racing, they say, comes first - before family, before friends and before work. From a 1969 Chevy Nova to a race-ready farm truck, the vehicles - and their drivers - come in all shapes and sizes and have one thing in common: the need for speed.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars
programme.desc: Renowned UK antiques dealer Drew Pritchard is always looking for new pieces, and he has no problem scouring the countryside to replenish his collection. On this series, a spin-off of `Salvage Hunters', Drew teams with automotive guru Paul Cowland to find, buy, fix up and sell classic cars and retro motorcycles. Drew's trained eye and deal-making skills combine with Paul's extensive mechanical knowledge and business acumen to power this venture. Along the way Drew also seeks out rare motoring memorabilia.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides: Road to the Ridler
programme.desc: The pinnacle of the custom car world is the Don Ridler award, given out every year at the Detroit Autorama. Dave Kindig has always had a Ridler-sized itch he needed to scratch.

programme.title: Dirt Every Day
programme.desc: Exploring and going on off-road adventures, in a wide variety of different vehicles.

programme.title: Seduced by Speed
programme.desc: Building fast cars takes guts, grit, madness, power, and vision, and the endeavour sometimes result in scandals that rock the automotive industry and the world.

programme.title: Car Fix
programme.desc: The hosts repair and modify all types of cars and also suggest easy ways to fix car-related problems.

programme.title: Garage Squad
programme.desc: Remember that cherished vintage car that's been collecting dust just waiting for a little love? `Garage Squad' rescues weekend mechanics who perhaps lack the time, resources or simple know-how to get their `project' autos road-worthy again. National Hot Rod Association world champion driver Bruno Massel, co-host Heather Storm and lead mechanic Joe Zolper bring expertise, parts and tools as they crash the garages of amateurs who are in over their heads under the hood. After working alongside the owners to ensure the perfect vehicular vision, the squad returns the completed cars for an emotional reuniting of man and machine.

programme.title: Faster With Finnegan
programme.desc: Armed with several years' worth of mechanical expertise, Mike Finnegan and his robust friends never shy away from fulfilling challenging tasks.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars

Drew's trained eye and deal-making skills combine with Paul's extensive mechanical knowledge and business acumen to power this venture. Along the way Drew also seeks out rare motoring memorabilia.

programme.title: Overhaulin'
programme.desc: A team of ace mechanics and designers transforms mundane or even junky autos into unique custom cars under the watchful eye of auto design legend Chip Foose. After a creative ruse gets each car into the shop, the work is done unbeknown to the cars' owners, deserving folks like returning veterans or people who are down on their luck, and each episode concludes with a surprise unveiling of the revamped ride. `Overhaulin' debuted on TLC in 2004 and ran for five seasons, then re-emerged with new episodes on Velocity in 2012. Chris Jacobs and model Arianny Celeste co-host.

programme.title: Fast N' Loud
programme.desc: Richard Rawlings and Aaron Kaufman deal in rusty gold. The proprietors of Gas Monkey Garage in Dallas buy and restore forgotten and fading away American cars, everything from 1931 Model A's to '73 Trans Ams, before selling them at auction. As `Fast N' Loud' documents, Rawlings is the mastermind, the deal-maker with an eye for the relics worth bringing back to life, and to find them the guys scour barns, swap meets and overgrown fields across Texas and surrounding states. The restorations are primarily managed by Kaufman, a fabricator and self-taught mechanic whose sharp skills and design savvy first endeared him to Rawlings and kick-started their partnership.

programme.title: Diesel Brothers
programme.desc: Buying diesel trucks headed for the scrap heap and giving them new leases on life has turned into big business for the Diesel Brothers. Led by Heavy D and Diesel Dave, the crew work hard and play harder as they trick out the trucks for use in elaborate pranks and stunts, all of which becomes a marketing tool on social media. Millions of hits later the company is known as the destination for diesel lovers who are looking for custom builds, crazy stunts, pranks and hilarious antics.

programme.title: You Have Been Warned
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: Factory Made
programme.desc: How to make all kinds of products, from the most common to the most complex.

programme.title: The Mind Control Freaks
programme.desc: Mind control is a phenomenon that not everyone necessarily believes in, but this programme may make more people think it's real with some of the mind manipulations that are featured. The show features master manipulators, including professional poker player Liv Boeree and mentalism expert Lewis Le Val, who use their abilities to influence others' actions. The results of some of their experiments include a man forgetting his fiancee, strangers giving away their car keys, and a boxer becoming unable to crush a foam cup.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'

programme.desc: The gold rush in Alaska isn't confined to the state's precious ground. It's taking place on the sea ... or more accurately, on the bottom of the frigid Bering Sea. programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid: Global Showdown
programme.desc: International survivalists work in duos across 40 days of wilderness, living to honour their countries and claim a monetary reward.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Born to Fight
programme.desc: Dan Barnes, a former professional boxer, takes up the responsibility to coach Matthew Miller, a teenager who is repeatedly bullied by a school boxing champion and his friends.

programme.title: The Starving Games
programme.desc: In a deadly game orchestrated by President Snowballs, skilled archer Kantmiss Evershot, her lover Dale and tech-savvy ally Peter Malarkey must rely on their wits and skills to survive.

programme.title: Southpaw
programme.desc: After a devastating accident shatters his world, a once-celebrated champion boxer spirals into a destructive abyss. Subsequently, he decides to fight for his daughter and revive his fading career.

programme.title: Mune
programme.desc: Necross, the former guardian of the sun, turns evil and steals it. Now, Mune, Glim and Sohone, three friends, must work together to retrieve it from him.

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane, an American girl travelling in Hong Kong, gets into a physical altercation with three robbers where she defends herself. A martial artist, who observes the event, trains her for a competition.

programme.title: Braven
programme.desc: A logger and his father head to their hunting cabin, hoping for a quiet weekend. Instead, they find themselves in a kill-or-be-killed stand for survival when they encounter a gang of drug traffickers.

programme.title: Dune
programme.desc: Paul, the young scion of House Atreides, faces troubling visions of the future. Meanwhile, his family fights to gain control over Arrakis, the only source of the valuable spice melange.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: When his former superior, Colonel Samuel, asks him to join him on a special mission in Afghanistan, Rambo declines. However, when he is held hostage and tortured, Rambo decides to step in.

programme.title: The Trust
programme.desc: Two financially stressed police officers discover that a petty drug dealer has hidden large amounts of money in a safe, and they plot to steal it. However, things do not go as planned.

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: Loretta Sage, a novelist of ancient tombs and daring quests, faces real-life peril when abducted by an eccentric billionaire seeking a mythical lost city. Meanwhile, Alan, her attractive book cover model, launches a clumsy rescue attempt. Together, they navigate jungle dangers and interpersonal conflicts to unearth the fabled treasure before it vanishes forever.

programme.title: Despicable Me

programme.title: My Soul to Take
programme.desc: On the night a serial killer dies, seven babies are born. Seventeen years later, as they die one by one, they race to discover if the killer's soul has returned.

programme.title: Attack
programme.desc: A terrorist attack renders Arjun paralysed and traumatised with thoughts of his dead lover. When the attacker returns, Arjun puts his life on the line to serve his nation and seek revenge.

programme.title: Second Hand Husband
programme.desc: Rajbir's wish to marry Gurpreet is delayed by his former wife, to whom he has to pay alimony until she remarries. Soon, he and his current partner hatch a plan to find her a potential suitor.

programme.title: Joggers' Park
programme.desc: Jyotin Chatterjee, a former judge, falls for Jenny, a young and independent woman. However, things take a turn when his family scrutinises their relationship.

programme.title: Loveshhuda
programme.desc: Gaurav ends up sleeping with Pooja at his own bachelor party. Even though the matter is soon forgotten and the two go on with their lives, they meet again years later for Pooja's bachelorette party.

programme.title: Mukkabaaz
programme.desc: Shravan Singh, an aspiring boxer, finds an enemy in Bhagwan Das Mishra, the head of a boxing federation. Thereafter, things take a turn for the worse after he falls for Bhagwan's niece, Sunaina.

programme.title: Blank
programme.desc: A suicide bomber named Hanif loses his memory before he could complete his mission. Resultantly, the Anti-Terrorism Squad must find out his real plan and save the country from a deadly attack.

programme.title: Notebook
programme.desc: Hoping for a change, a former army officer takes a job as a teacher at a remote school in Kashmir. When he discovers a notebook from a previous instructor, he soon finds himself falling in love with a woman he has never met.

programme.title: U-Turn
programme.desc: Rachana, an intern at a newspaper, investigates accidents occurring on a flyover with the help of a crime reporter. However, the situation changes when she is accused of murder.

programme.title: Operation Romeo
programme.desc: A young man and a woman in love head out during the nocturnal hours. However, chaos ensues when they meet two strangers on their way.

programme.title: Hotel Mumbai
programme.desc: A hotel staff risks everything to keep its patrons safe during a terror attack, especially a British heiress, her husband and her infant.

programme.title: Sanam Teri Kasam
programme.desc: A librarian, cast out by her family, asks her neighbour to help her find a suitable husband. However, their growing feelings for each other complicate the situation.

programme.title: Happy Phirr Bhag Jayegi
programme.desc: Harpreet Kaur, a woman who travels to China to find her fiancé, gets mistakenly kidnapped by gangsters whose assignment was to abduct another woman of the same name travelling by the same flight.

programme.desc: Shalini, a former nursing student from Kerala, who later becomes the wife of a terrorist, testifies her life story and her journey from being a naive girl to another victim of terrorism.

programme.title: Pyar Kiye Jaa
programme.desc: Ramlal, a widower, struggles to find suitable grooms for his daughters and to control his son's film obsession. To make matters worse, one of his former employees launches a protest against him.

programme.title: My Life My Story
programme.desc: The host invites prominent Bollywood celebrities who open up about their personal life and share interesting anecdotes based on their experiences.

programme.title: Narada Vijaya
programme.desc: Narada, a celestial being, is forced to descend to Earth and interact with humans. However, complications arise when he is mistaken for Vijay, a police officer.

programme.title: Dastaan-E-Rafi
programme.desc: Renowned celebrities discuss the life journey of gifted singer Mohammed Rafi, sharing moments and incidents they experienced with him during his career.

programme.title: Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi
programme.desc: When Sadhana marries Deepak, her manipulative mother urges her to harass her mother-in-law. Subsequently, she also meddles in her son's marriage, turning their lives into a web of misery.

programme.title: Dil Ne Phir Yaad Kiya
programme.desc: Ashok, a salesman, is in love with Ashoo and wants to marry her. However, things take a turn when his brother kidnaps Ashoo.

programme.title: Nafrat Ki Aandhi
programme.desc: Ravi Kapoor, a police officer and Sonu Dada, a former criminal, join hands together to take down a notorious gangster, Chandi Das.

programme.title: Immaan Dharam
programme.desc: Petty crooks Ahmed and Mohan decide to change their ways after meeting the virtuous Kabir Das. However, when Kabir is implicated in a murder case, the duo decides to help him but gets into trouble.

programme.title: Andhaa Kanoon
programme.desc: When his parents are killed by three men, Amar, Akbar and Anthony, Vijay teams up with a forest officer who was framed in a murder case to avenge their deaths.

programme.title: Naina
programme.desc: After years of blindness caused by an accident, Naina gets a successful cornea transplant. However, she soon begins to see terrifying visions that prompt her to investigate the source of her sight.

programme.title: Hanste Zakham

programme.title: Jazbaat
programme.desc: A woman's life takes an unexpected turn when she joins a dance troupe. However, complications arise when she returns to her village.

programme.title: Bhoomi Par Bhagwan

programme.title: Chitchor

programme.title: Hoshiyar
programme.desc: Sitadevi's life turns upside down when her husband dies in an accident. To add to her sorrow, one of her sons is separated from her and grows up to be a criminal.

programme.title: Apne Apne
programme.desc: Ravi gets married to Sharda against his mother's wish. However, when Sharda suffers a miscarriage and leaves Ravi, he marries Seema, a rich woman.

programme.title: Amrit
programme.desc: A widowed man and woman face abuse from their respective children and seek comfort from each other instead.

programme.title: Balidaan
programme.desc: Police Inspector Vijay makes an enemy of bandit Ranga after he kills one of his men. After the vengeful Ranga wilfully abducts Vijay's wife and daughter, he must race against time to save his family.

programme.title: Insaaf Kaun Karega
programme.desc: Jageera abandons his wife and son Vikram to join a life of crime. Years later, when Vikram, now a police officer, sets out to put an end to Jageera's activities, he swears to kill him.

programme.title: Naya Daur
programme.desc: A man introduces a bus service in an attempt to make quick profits and endangers the peace and livelihood of local farmers and workers.

programme.desc: Despite having made the difficult decision to separate, Dolly pretends to love her husband when her father comes to visit.

programme.title: Mangni
programme.desc: A woman faces criticism from various people due to her appearance and experiences rejection from the man she fancies at college.

programme.title: My Life My Story
programme.desc: The host invites prominent Bollywood celebrities who open up about their personal life and share interesting anecdotes based on their experiences.

programme.title: Bulundi
programme.desc: Professor Khurana is recruited by a rich man to tutor his wayward son, Manjit. Later Khurana also takes on his friends, Vikram and Pawan. Unbeknownst to him, his students have a nasty plan for him.

programme.title: Bhagwaan Dada
programme.desc: Bhagwaan, a reformed criminal, rescues Swaroop, a naive villager. Swaroop rescues Bijli, a young woman targeted by Shambu. The situation regresses when Shambu decides to exact revenge.

programme.title: You Guys Are Couple Goals
programme.desc: Then - You see a hint of jealousy in Riya and Varun's relationship when they were still together. Now - Riya and Varun are "trying" to date other people(while they live together) with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Mera Spondylitis Phoot Gaya!
programme.desc: An unfortunate accident leads to Riya and Varun realizing the small ways in which their relationship has changed since they were together.

programme.title: Bhen-dad!
programme.desc: A surprise visit from Riya's dad sends Riya, Varun, and Devika in disarray as they have to scramble to make sure he doesn't find out Riya and Varun are not a couple anymore.

programme.title: Mamla Gehra Hai
programme.desc: Riya and Varun are forced to make tough decisions about their future together in the house. To add to their woes, a burglary at the house leaves them deprived of a special possession.

programme.title: Humanize the Ex
programme.desc: To celebrate their stay at the house, the exes - Riya and Varun - decide to have a bonfire party on their lawn. There, they reminisce about their relationship so far.

programme.title: Naye Armaan
programme.desc: Varun turns 30, and Ria is introduced to Anisha. Back in the day, Varun and Ria finally move into a house together.

programme.title: Humesha
programme.desc: Ria decides to go home and tell her parents the truth about Varun and Ria's breakup. Back in the day, Varun and Ria's parents come over as the families meet and make plans for their future.

programme.title: Khwaab
programme.desc: Ria finally admits to having feelings for Varun. Back in the day, we see trouble in Varun and Ria's relationship for the first time.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan Short fell in love with cars when he first laid eyes on a 1967 Camaro. He bought a used model as a teenager, but because he couldn't pay someone else to restore it, he learned how to do the work himself. After a stint in the Army, Short decided to make his passion for classic cars his life's work, and FantomWorks was born. Today the Norfolk, Va., company is the largest auto restoration shop in the U.S., and this reality series shows how Short and his team meticulously refurbish some of America's favorite rides. Drama ensues in the form of personality clashes, cost overruns, irate customers and other issues, which are compounded by Short's reputation as a straight shooter who won't accept substandard results.

programme.title: Love Love Love
programme.desc: Amit, the son of a taxi driver, and Reema, a rich businessman's daughter, fall in love. However, Reema's father wants to marry her to Vicky, whose father is the biggest gangster in Mumbai. How will their love triumph?

programme.title: I M 24
programme.desc: A 42-year-old writer falls in love with a 22-year-old beauty queen. However, things get complicated when his roommate encourages him to make up stories to impress her.

programme.title: Do Premee
programme.desc: Lovers Payal and Chetan elope as their families disapprove of their relationship. They start a new life working for Geeta, unaware of her true nature and affiliations.

programme.title: Dance Dance
programme.desc: Two siblings, Radha and Ramu, belong to a poor family. Their life takes an unexpected turn when a tragic incident leaves them orphaned.

programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: S.P. Chauhan
programme.desc: Satpal Chauhan, a social worker from Haryana, works for women empowerment and also strives to create an alcohol-free society. However, while pursuing his goals, he faces several hardships.

programme.title: Bombai Ka Babu
programme.desc: Babu, who kills a man, is blackmailed by Bhagat into assuming the identity of a wealthy heir, Kundan, for his money. However, things get complicated when Babu falls in love with Kundan's sister.

programme.title: Neel Kamal
programme.desc: Sita's sleepwalking turns out to be a cause of concern to her husband and family. When they investigate, they realize that her current behaviour is linked to her previous life.

programme.title: Mera Damad
programme.desc: Jai's father asks him to meet Sunita before getting married to her. However, complications arise when Jai falls in love with Kimi, while on his way to Sunita's village.

programme.title: Officer Arjun Singh IPS
programme.desc: Arjun Pratap Singh, an IPS officer, strives to overcome multiple challenges and embarks on a mission to restore peace in society.

programme.title: Chaand Kaa Tukdaa
programme.desc: NRI Shyam comes to India to fulfil the final wish of his late mother who wanted him to marry an Indian girl. Unbeknownst to him, the girl he falls in love with is a pawn in the hands of his enemies.

programme.title: Chaand Kaa Tukdaa
programme.desc: NRI Shyam comes to India to fulfil the final wish of his late mother who wanted him to marry an Indian girl. Unbeknownst to him, the girl he falls in love with is a pawn in the hands of his enemies.

programme.title: Deadline: Sirf 24 Ghante
programme.desc: Anishka, the daughter of a doctor, is kidnapped, and the abductors demand a hefty ransom. When Dr Viren abides by their rules and delivers the money, the kidnappers vanish with the money and Anishka.

programme.title: Maharathi
programme.desc: After his boss, Jai Singh, commits suicide, Subhash, a chauffeur, conspires to get his insurance money. He then teams up with Jai's wife, Mallika, to make the suicide look like a well-planned murder.

programme.title: Anita
programme.desc: When Anita commits suicide, Neeraj suspects foul play and decides to investigate the truth. However, things take a turn when he starts seeing Anita everywhere.

programme.title: Waqt Ki Awaz
programme.desc: A rich girl runs away from home and settles down with a truck driver. However, her dream life is shattered when she learns that her new lover has been accused of murder.

programme.title: Dil Kya Kare
programme.desc: The parents of an adopted child face issues of love, betrayal and custody when their daughter's birth mother arrives.

programme.title: Souten

programme.desc: SAANJH tells the story of Shyam and Sandhya, childhood friends who meet for the last time. Shyam loves Sandhya, but she sees him only as a friend. programme.title: Animal Armoury
programme.desc: Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skillfully crafted tricks of the trade. "Animal Armory" incorporates high-end imagery and computer graphics to reveal how wildlife use their teeth, claws, antlers, camouflage, venom and even spit to threaten and intimidate rivals and predators alike. With weapons of deception, animals disarm and entice prey to their death. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

programme.title: Python Hunters
programme.desc: With invasive species invading Florida, it is up to animal control officers to deal with and get rid of the invading animals. Green iguanas, Nile monitors, rock pythons and Burmese pythons are among the most common species entering the Sunshine State. An elite squad of hunters, known as the Python Hunters, is fighting back. The Python Hunters are tasked with protecting the local environment by getting the invasive species under control. It's an important conservation mission and, if it fails, one of America's most-important ecosystems may never be able to recover.

programme.title: Zoo Clues
programme.desc: With all of the various animal species roaming around the planet there's a lot to know about animals, which means no one knows everything about them. Thankfully "Zoo Clues" fills in some of the blanks. Each half-hour episode investigates at least a dozen questions about animals to provide viewers with answers. Have you ever wondered if birds can fly backward, how animals without external ears hear, or why zebras have stripes? Those are among the questions waiting for answers on "Zoo Clues."

Green iguanas, Nile monitors, rock pythons and Burmese pythons are among the most common species entering the Sunshine State. An elite squad of hunters, known as the Python Hunters, is fighting back. The Python Hunters are tasked with protecting the local environment by getting the invasive species under control. It's an important conservation mission and, if it fails, one of America's most-important ecosystems may never be able to recover.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Little Singham
programme.desc: Little Singham, an honest but ferocious police officer, fights against injustice and defends his town from formidable enemies.

programme.title: American Monster: Abuse of Power
programme.desc: From police officers to pastors, doctors to business leaders, they are the pillars of our communities. However, when power seduces and corrupts, it opens the door to evil, and some will stop at nothing, even murder, to protect themselves.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer
programme.desc: Disturbing yet empowering accounts of how people have escaped the clutches of a serial killer.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: An exploration into the dangers of meeting up with strangers through Internet dating sites. Featuring stories from families and friends of victims who have fallen victim to online predators.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: UFO experts Mitch Horowitz and Chrissy Newton use scientific data and research to dissect real-life encounters with extraterrestrial activity and determine whether they can be explained.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: Exploring the ripple effects of a single murder on multiple lives, as loved ones, eyewitnesses and law enforcement personnel reflect on how the past continues to haunt the present.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: Fictionalised first-person narratives are used to explore different cases of murder and betrayal at the hands of a loved one or friend.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Telling the real stories of men and women who lived happy, seemingly normal lives with the people they loved - and who they thought they knew. When a clue or mishap causes them to dig further into the secret lives of their spouses, the shocking truths lead them to wonder who it is they really fell in love with. The stories include husbands with multiple families, spies working under cover, those who steal thousands of dollars, and others whose double lives include murder.

Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: UFO experts Mitch Horowitz and Chrissy Newton use scientific data and research to dissect real-life encounters with extraterrestrial activity and determine whether they can be explained.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Telling the real stories of men and women who lived happy, seemingly normal lives with the people they loved - and who they thought they knew. When a clue or mishap causes them to dig further into the secret lives of their spouses, the shocking truths lead them to wonder who it is they really fell in love with. The stories include husbands with multiple families, spies working under cover, those who steal thousands of dollars, and others whose double lives include murder.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: You Have Been Warned
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: Factory Made
programme.desc: How to make all kinds of products, from the most common to the most complex.

programme.title: The Mind Control Freaks
programme.desc: Mind control is a phenomenon that not everyone necessarily believes in, but this programme may make more people think it's real with some of the mind manipulations that are featured. The show features master manipulators, including professional poker player Liv Boeree and mentalism expert Lewis Le Val, who use their abilities to influence others' actions. The results of some of their experiments include a man forgetting his fiancee, strangers giving away their car keys, and a boxer becoming unable to crush a foam cup.

programme.title: Deadliest Catch
programme.desc: Before complaining about the market price of Alaska king crab, check out this gripping documentary series, revealing the mortal perils and intense discomfort that fishing crews face to catch the delicacy; those perils include 40-foot waves, 700-pound crab pots that can easily crush a careless crewman, and freezing temperatures around the clock.

programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life
programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: After watching this series you may never look at ordinary objects in the same way again. A tube of toothpaste? Car tires? Tea bags? A lot of technology goes into even the simplest of consumer goods, and this program offers viewers a glimpse at just what that entails.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called `Popaholics.' Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a `celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades.'

programme.title: Web
programme.desc:
Four girls are kidnapped while returning from a rave party. They were drunk and driving rashly. They wake up to find themselves tied up in a secluded and unkempt bunglow. There is a fifth girl who has been tortured since long. Brutally beaten. The torture begins for these 4 girls. The man and woman who keep them hostage have CCTVs installed in the room where these girls are kept. Thus whenever they try to run away, or make any move are captured back. These goes on for days and then one day the kidnapper kills one of the girl's and feeds her to his dog, as she finds out that her husband has also been killed by the same man.
Later, the woman assisting the kidnapper reveals his story to these girls. The kidnapper had a sister, and she gets killed by a rash driving. Thus anyone who is driving irresponsibly will have to pay the price.
Towards the end these 3 girls manage to escape and reach their homes, only to discover that the kidnapper was actually one of the leading psychiatrist and was requested by their parents to treat the daughters from alcohol and drug abuse and addiction.
Since the traditional methods were tried earlier and lack of cooperation from patients yield no results, thus they reached out to this doctor.
Hence the doctor along with his colleagues & the two friends (whom were thought to have been killed) devise a 21 days treatment plan & everything was just part of it.

programme.desc: À l'émission "Curieux Bégin", on parle de cuisine et de vin, mais on prend aussi le temps de rire et de s'amuser. On s'intéresse à l'histoire des invités et à leur culture. programme.title: Curieux Bégin
programme.desc: À l'émission "Curieux Bégin", on parle de cuisine et de vin, mais on prend aussi le temps de rire et de s'amuser. On s'intéresse à l'histoire des invités et à leur culture. Christian Bégin nous entraîne dans de délicieuses aventures épicuriennes. Ses invités nous font découvrir plusieurs cultures grâce à leurs expériences et à leurs recettes. Dynamique et pétillante, l'émission "Curieux Bégin" explore de nombreux thèmes dans un univers festif.
